history.summary: Brand-new (2024) 1,451-unit Oxley mega-development at $1,567 psf — ~11% below the URA median ($1,752) — but the resale-only CAGR is a modest 4.07% and the sheer scale plus a 1.4km walk to Hougang MRT cap the upside. The size that aids liquidity also creates a heavy internal-supply overhang for resale and rental for years.
history.rating_rationale: 861sqft 2BR at $1.349M / $1,567 psf is ~11% below median PSF ($1,752) with a deep 573-transaction dataset, but resale-only appreciation is just 4.07% (OCR-typical) and momentum is muted. The 1,451-unit scale means hundreds of competing units will hit resale/rental simultaneously, pressuring exit pricing. 1.4km to Hougang NE14 is a real walkability weakness vs MRT-fronting peers. Good facilities and below-median entry keep it off Avoid, but mega-supply overhang plus average appreciation make it a Neutral hold. MMR 1543 / score 764.
red_flags: 1,451 units — massive internal competing supply on resale and rental
1.4km / 17min walk to Hougang MRT (no direct station)
Recent 2024 TOP — many investor units will list together
catalysts: 573 transactions = high data confidence and liquidity

history.summary: Genuinely cheap 1BR in a large, well-located D19 (OCR) project — asking $1,547 psf vs a verified project average of ~$1,732 psf — in the highest-realized-forward-return region. The discount looks real and is the cheapest of this batch with deep, trustworthy data.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,547 psf sits clearly below the verified last-12-month project range of $1,495-$1,928 psf (avg ~$1,732), so the algo's age_adj_premium of -19.7% and psf_premium_vs_cohort of -4.5% are backed by real transactions, not a quirk. Data depth is the strongest in this batch: 573 appreciation txns and a 40-unit psf cohort, no red flags. It sits in OCR (D19), the region with the best realized forward returns (~+4.0%) under v3.4 priors, and the small $800k quantum keeps it liquid. The ~4.5% URA 5yr CAGR is story only (de-emphasized), but the value case stands on verified comps.
red_flags: 517 sqft 1BR is a compact format with no study — narrower tenant pool than a 1+study
1,472-unit mega-development means high concurrent resale supply competing on exit
99-yr lease from 2018 — lease decay clock running, though young
catalysts: OCR (D19) is the strongest realized forward-return region in the v3.4 backtest
Verified discount to project average (~$185 psf below avg) gives margin of safety
Riverside/serene setting near Hougang/Sengkang amenities supports rental demand (~3.7% yield)
